author: ZORA_CROZO
quote: Honestly, I had incredibly high expectations for this game, but what a massive disappointment. All the suspense, excitement, and fun are completely ruined. I can't believe how boring this game turned out to be. It feels less like an actual game and more like a dating simulator with a few gameplay elements thrown in. The pacing is dull, the story fails to keep you hooked, and instead of feeling excitement or suspense, I find myself waiting for something interesting to happen. What a waste of potential. I expected an unforgettable experience, but got a snoozefest instead. Well, it is what it is.
